input.quote: NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR ANY SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, PUNITIVE, OR INDIRECT DAMAGES OR LOST PROFITS ARISING FROM OR RELATING TO ANY BREACH OF THIS AGREEMENT, REGARDLESS OF ANY NOTICE OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES. NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS OF ANY PARTY UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2, OR DAMAGES AVAILABLE FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS RELATING TO CONFIDENTIALITY UNDER ARTICLE XI OR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY UNDER ARTICLE X.
input.rationale: Section 14.5 is the only limitation-of-liability provision in the Agreement (Article XIV otherwise contains indemnity, mitigation and insurance terms only, and Section 14.6 confirms insurance does not limit indemnity liability). It is a mutual exclusion of special, consequential, incidental, punitive and indirect damages, with carve-outs preserving indemnification under Sections 14.1/14.2 and damages for breach of confidentiality (Article XI) and intellectual property (Article X). However, no aggregate monetary cap exists anywhere in the document (the only "exceed" ceiling is the $520,000,000 Milestone Payment limit in Section 9.2), so Sanofi's direct liability, including for its Research, Development, Manufacture and Commercialization activities, is unlimited. That fails the fallback requirement of a mutual cap based on 12 months of fees, so we add the shortest conforming cap sentence inside Section 14.5 (so the retained indemnification and confidentiality carve-outs continue to sit outside it) and expressly keep gross negligence and willful misconduct uncapped. The preferred USD 1,000,000 floor and the data protection, fraud, IP and payment-obligation carve-outs are noted but not pressed for this collaboration structure.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap of 12 months' fees to Section 14.5, with gross negligence and willful misconduct (alongside the existing indemnification, confidentiality and IP carve-outs) outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.5 excludes consequential damages but leaves each Party's direct liability entirely uncapped, so we have added a mutual aggregate cap of 12 months' fees. Consistent with our fallback position, the existing indemnification and confidentiality carve-outs in this Section continue to sit outside the cap, and we have expressly kept gross negligence and willful misconduct uncapped.

ops.text: EXCEPT AS PROVIDED IN THE PRECEDING SENTENCE AND WITH RESPECT TO A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY SANOFI UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
